C: › [ C ] a tall, wide evergreen tree (= one that never loses its leaves)
U: › [ U ] also cedarwood the wood of this tree

NONE: › to allow someone else to have or own something, especially unwillingly or because you are forced to do so
（尤指不情願地或被迫）割讓，讓予，放棄

example: Hong Kong was ceded to Britain after the Opium War.
鴉片戰爭後香港被割讓給英國。

NONE: › (used when writing some languages) a mark made under a letter, especially c, then written as ç, to show that the letter has a special sound
下加變音符，尾形符（尤指字母c寫作ç）
